commands.name: gitignore
commands.description:
Diff the local .gitignore against the GitHub Visual Studio template and report
missing rules. Optionally merge them

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --merge
options.description:
Appends all missing rules to the local .gitignore, grouped by
section. Original content is preserved

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Repository root path to check. Defaults to current directory

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Export project-to-project references as a Mermaid or GraphViz dependency diagram

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --format
options.description:
Diagram format: 'mermaid' (default) or 'dot'
(GraphViz)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write the diagram to this file. Defaults to the
scanned Git repository root, or
%APPDATA%\Spargine\graphs

options.name: --solution
options.description:
Explicit .sln file to graph. Overrides
auto-discovery under PATH

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description:
Root path containing the solution/projects to graph. Defaults to
current directory

commands.name: health
commands.description:
Analyze .NET projects for health issues: outdated TFMs, vulnerable/outdated
packages, and missing MSBuild properties

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --outdated
options.description: Check for outdated NuGet packages (requires internet)

options.name: --vulnerable
options.description:
Check for vulnerable NuGet packages (requires
internet)

options.name: --tfm
options.description:
Minimum acceptable TFM (e.g., net8.0). Default:
net8.0

options.name: --output
options.description:
Also save the report to this file. Use a .md
extension for Markdown

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root path to scan. Defaults to current directory

commands.name: metrics
commands.description: Track build warnings, errors, and package vulnerability trends over time

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --history
options.description:
Number of historical snapshots to display in the
trend table (default: 10, max: 100)

options.name: --no-packages
options.description:
Skip the NuGet vulnerable/outdated package scan
(faster, works offline)

options.name: --solution
options.description:
Explicit .sln file to build. Overrides
auto-discovery under PATH

options.name: --output
options.description:
Also save the report to this file. Use a .md
extension for Markdown

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description:
Root path containing the solution to measure. Defaults to current
directory
